claims.title: Two conditionally independent categorical views sharing one latent component have joint law K^T diag(pi) K
claims.scope: finite latent mixture with two iid emissions conditional on the same latent label
assumptions: the two views share latent identity
the views are conditionally independent given that identity
nonclaims: independently redrawn latent labels produce a different law

claims.title: Affine independence and linear independence coincide for finite probability-vector rows
claims.scope: finite row family in a probability simplex
nonclaims: the equivalence is stated for probability-vector rows

claims.title: Under full affine rank and strictly positive transformed prior, preserving one- and two-view laws forces an invertible nonnegative row-stochastic gauge to be a permutation
claims.scope: finite categorical latent-mixture gauge K'=AK, pi'=pi A^{-1}
assumptions: K has full affine row rank
A is invertible, nonnegative, and row-stochastic
the shared-latent two-view law is preserved
nonclaims: the theorem is not a complete identifiability theorem for arbitrary latent models

claims.title: Two observations with independently redrawn latent labels have product law q tensor q and cannot break a one-view factorization gauge
claims.scope: two independent repetitions of the fully marginalized one-view mixture distribution
assumptions: the latent component is redrawn independently before each observation
nonclaims: shared-latent repeated measurements have a different joint law

claims.title: Cross-observation structure tied to persistent latent identity can identify factorization information absent from the one-view marginal
claims.scope: the full-rank positive-prior gauge family under shared-latent conditionally independent two-view observations
nonclaims: not every multi-view latent model is identifiable

claims.title: The binary one-view gauge witness changes its two-view law from diagonal halves to a matrix with one-eighth off-diagonal mass
claims.scope: uniform binary prior, identity channel, and gauge [[3/4,1/4],[0,1]]
assumptions: two emissions are iid conditional on the shared latent label

claims.title: Rank-deficient identical component rows admit a nonpermutation gauge preserving the two-view law
claims.scope: two identical deterministic binary component rows with positive latent weights
assumptions: full affine rank is intentionally violated
nonclaims: the counterexample does not contradict the full-rank rigidity theorem

claims.title: A zero-mass latent component can be changed by a nonpermutation gauge without changing one- or two-view observations
claims.scope: full-rank binary identity channel with prior (1,0)
nonclaims: the counterexample does not apply to strictly positive transformed priors

claims.title: Bounded exact two-view gauge-rigidity audit
claims.scope: binary detection, permutation invariance, K3 nonpermutation detection, rank-deficient boundary, zero-mass boundary, and joint-law normalization
assumptions: all probabilities and matrix operations use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded checks are not empirical evidence for simulation
